objective: Diagnose and fix the current-head Backend Tests ambient process-package timeout

ci_failure.step: Run GitLab-facing packages under a poisoned host environment
ci_failure.observed: process package reached the default 10m0s timeout while TestSlowPollFailedScanDoesNotAdvanceBackoff was in setupTestRepo/runGitCombinedOutput; test reported 0s

root_cause.classification: cumulative package runtime, not a hang specific to the final reported test
evidence: The named test passes alone under race detection and the poisoned GitLab environment (1.107s package time).
The exact-head full process package passes locally at 445.135s under race detection and the same poison, showing substantial cumulative cost.
The baseline slow-storage test took 119.71s for 7,200 full-tail updates; the interleaved case took 15.35s for 800 updates.
The final test was blocked in Git setup only after the suite's 10-minute alarm; its 0s label is time since that test started.
root_cause.inference: The hosted ambient job runs the GitLab and process packages concurrently; runner and I/O contention pushed the already long process package past Go's unchanged 10-minute default.

fix.summary: Reduce redundant full-tail durable updates from 7,200 to 1,025 while keeping real 256 KiB output, exact reconstruction, and two checkpoint rollovers. Assert exactly three checkpoints and tighten the serialized-output cap from 32 MiB to 3 MiB. Reduce interleaved updates from 800 to 520 so the test still crosses the shared 512-update threshold, then assert per-tool checkpoint independence, ordering, reconstructed outputs, and a tighter 2 MiB serialization cap.
